formulas.name: Case24HrsDate
formulas.expression: CASE( MOD(DATEVALUE({!CaseOnHoldDate})- DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 1, /*if CloseDate is Sun,CloseDate+1=Monday */ 1, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 1, /*if CloseDate is Mon,CloseDate+1=Tuesday */ 2, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 1, /*if CloseDate is Tues,CloseDate+1=Wednesday */ 3, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 1, /*if CloseDate is Wed,CloseDate+1=Thursday*/ 4, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 1, /*if CloseDate is Thurs,CloseDate+1=Friday */ 5, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 3, /*if CloseDate is Fri,CloseDate+3=Monday next week */ 6, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+2, /*if CloseDate is Sat,CloseDate+2=Monday next week */ NULL)

formulas.name: Case48HrsDate
formulas.expression: CASE( MOD(DATEVALUE({!CaseOnHoldDate})- DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+2, /*if On_Hold_Date__c is Sun,CloseDate+1=Tuesday*/ 1, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 2, /*if On_Hold_Date__c is Mon,CloseDate+1=Wednesday*/ 2, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 2, /*if On_Hold_Date__c is Tues,CloseDate+1=Thursday*/ 3, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 2, /*if CloseDate is Wed,CloseDate+1=Friday*/ 4, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+4, /*if CloseDate is Thurs,CloseDate+1=Monday Next Week*/ 5, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+4, /*if CloseDate is Fri,CloseDate+3=Tuesday Next Week*/ 6, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+3, /*if CloseDate is Sat,CloseDate+2=Tuesday NextWeek */ NULL)

formulas.name: Case72HrsDate
formulas.expression: CASE( MOD(DATEVALUE({!CaseOnHoldDate})- DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+3, /*if CloseDate is Sun,CloseDate+1=Wednesday*/ 1, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 3, /*if CloseDate is Mon,CloseDate+1=Thursday*/ 2, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+3, /*if CloseDate is Tues,CloseDate+1=Friday */ 3, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+5, /*if CloseDate is Wed,CloseDate+1=Monday*/ 4, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+ 5, /*if CloseDate is Thurs,CloseDate+1=Tuesday*/ 5, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+5, /*if CloseDate is Fri,CloseDate+3=Wednesday next week */ 6, {!CaseOnHoldDate}+4, /*if CloseDate is Sat,CloseDate+2=Wednesday next week */ NULL)
